lessonTitle: Lesson 1 · 夏日出行怎么打包
en: And there were several people on that tour who were all - they seemed to be much more seasoned travelers than I was, and they just all immediately whipped out their rain jackets.
zh: 那个团里有好几个人，他们全都——他们看起来都比我有经验多了，一下子全都掏出了雨衣。
note: -ed 读 /t/ 并连到 out：听感像 whip-tout-their

lessonTitle: Lesson 1 · 夏日出行怎么打包
en: And I didn't have any of my rain gear.
note: rain gear = 雨具（雨衣/雨披等统称）；gear 在口语里很轻

lessonTitle: Lesson 1 · 夏日出行怎么打包
en: She was getting absolutely dumped on.
note: 口语 get dumped on = 被大雨浇透；dumped 爆破音弱，容易漏听 on

lessonTitle: Lesson 1 · 夏日出行怎么打包
en: And I didn't have any of my rain gear.
note: didn't 的 t 几乎不爆破；have any → hav-enee；of 弱读 uv
